findings.title: Inconsistent Logo Kerning
findings.problem: The letters are spaced unevenly (tight 'MD', loose 'EL'), making the brand name look accidental or like a typo rather than a stylized logo.
findings.why: It undermines the professional polish of the game immediately upon launch; the player hesitates on how to pronounce or read the name.
findings.fix: Adjust the tracking/kerning of the title font to be uniform, or intentionally group letters (e.g., 'SM DUEL') with clear spacing to create a deliberate logotype.

findings.title: Abstract Vehicle Preview
findings.where: Constructor screen, right-hand panel ('SUBCOMPACT - TOP VIEW').
findings.problem: The visualization is a generic blue wireframe with rectangles, completely disconnected from the detailed orange tank sprite seen in gameplay.
findings.why: It fails to give the player feedback on their customization; they are building a 'car' but looking at a schematic, reducing the emotional connection to their creation.
findings.fix: Replace the wireframe with a rendered top-down view of the actual vehicle sprite (or a simplified silhouette) that updates as parts are added.

findings.title: Low-Contrast Radar Display
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom-left corner (Radar panel).
findings.problem: The radar face is nearly black with a very faint, low-opacity green sweep and thin grid lines, making it difficult to distinguish from the panel background.
findings.why: In a vehicular combat game, situational awareness is critical; a hard-to-read radar causes the player to miss incoming threats or navigation cues.
findings.fix: Increase the opacity and brightness of the radar sweep (e.g., bright cyan/green) and thicken the concentric grid lines to ensure the instrument reads clearly against the dark UI panel.

findings.title: Poor Building-to-Ground Contrast
findings.where: City screen, the cluster of buildings inside the circular wall.
findings.problem: The gray building sprites lack drop shadows or distinct outlines against the similar-toned blue-gray cracked concrete ground, making them look flat and hard to distinguish as obstacles.
findings.why: It hurts spatial readability; the player cannot instantly parse safe driving paths versus collidable structures, leading to accidental crashes or confusion.
findings.fix: Add a consistent dark drop shadow to all building sprites and/or slightly desaturate/darken the ground texture to create clear separation between the 'floor' and the 'objects'.

findings.title: Repetitive Weapon Slot List
findings.problem: The UI lists ten individual rows of text saying '(empty)', which looks like a debug console or spreadsheet rather than a game interface.
findings.why: It creates unnecessary visual clutter and implies a tedious, menu-heavy customization process rather than an engaging build phase.
findings.fix: Replace the long text list with a visual grid of weapon icons or a single 'Add Weapon' slot that expands, hiding empty slots until they are needed.
